description: This is a unit test class for the FeaturesCreated class, testing JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, and error conditions.

classes.name: FeaturesCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeaturesCreated, verifying JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and error handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that FeaturesCreated class instances are immutable and that Features are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods for FeaturesCreated class.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturesCreated with null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturesCreated with null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatures
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturesCreated with null features throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Checks that creating a FeaturesCreated instance from valid JSON produces a correct object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithNullFeatures
methods.description: Tests that parsing JSON with null features results in null features field.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getResourcePath returns the correct JSON Pointer.
